title: Implement modified Mori-Tanaka schemes
action: Code the stepwise differential Mori-Tanaka algorithm with merged and open-cell modifications, including Eshelby tensor computations for spherical and ellipsoidal inclusions.
description: Write the computational procedures for the classical MT, MMT (merged pores), and OMT (open-cell pores) as functions that take porosity, material constants, and pore size distribution and return the effective Young's modulus.

title: Compute predicted Young's moduli across porosities
action: For each porosity level in [10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90]%, compute E_MT, E_MMT, and E_OMT using the implemented models and save the results to /app/outputs/predicted_moduli.csv.
description: A CSV file containing the effective Young's modulus (in GPa) predicted by each of the three models for each porosity level. For OMT, open porosity φ_open is equal to total porosity φ at the given level.
output_schema: Header row with column names: porosity,E_MT,E_MMT,E_OMT. Columns: porosity (integer percent, 10-90), E_MT (float, GPa), E_MMT (float, GPa), E_OMT (float, GPa).
